Concerns · Hair

Female pattern hair loss, taken seriously.

Androgenetic alopecia is the most common cause of thinning hair in women, and one of the least researched. This is what we built Saede for.

Why hair first

Because it is where our founder's own story started — and because female pattern hair loss sits in a strange gap. It is extremely common, it changes how a woman sees herself, and it is studied far less in women than the same condition is in men.

Androgenetic alopecia is driven by how your follicles respond to androgens, and to DHT in particular. Sensitive follicles produce finer, shorter hairs with each cycle until they stop altogether, usually showing first at the parting and the temples. It is not cosmetic, and it is not vanity.

It also rarely arrives alone. Stress and cortisol, hormonal and metabolic shifts, and the nutrient gaps underneath all move together — which is why we built one system for all of it rather than a vitamin for the symptom.

The roots we work on are not hair problems. They are body problems that show up in the hair first.

The main character

Saede Hero

Daily capsule

The daily capsule, and the main character. Hero goes after the root causes rather than the symptom — the androgen activity, the stress load, and the micronutrients your hair is actually built from.

This is the part of the routine our founder found first, and the reason her hair loss slowed the first time.

The trusted partner

Daily powder

The powder beside Hero, and the half most brands leave out because it is expensive and it does not fit in a capsule. It is the part our founder added second — and the point at which the hair loss stopped rather than slowed.

What is coming

PCOS, gut, metabolic health.

The same roots, approached from different directions. We are working on them properly, which means slowly, and we would rather say nothing than announce a date we cannot keep.

If you want to know when something new arrives, the Learn hub is where we will say so first.
